response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), s AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_tat_diff FROM s
